scope.method: Baseline tracked text screened for historical years and owner/identity terms; inspected lineage, profiles, timeline, historical chronicle, canonical manuscript, R50/R53 development registers and supplemental images. Keyword screening is not exhaustive semantic proof. No blanket OCR of every binary or external repository archive. New mission evidence is a join aid, not independent corroboration. Network failure is not evidence of absence.

rule.text: Literary dynasties, personal championship counts, inherited grudges, and owner-specific ancient history may only use verified human-owner continuity. Until then, slot-level historical facts remain attached to the slot/team name.

slot_caution.text: Status: VERIFIED SLOT HISTORY; owner identity is NOT inferred from slot continuity.

jake.text: Historical slot lineage: Scruffy Looking Nerf Herders → Obi-Wan Jacoby → Benedict Kenobi → ObiWan Jacoby.

kevin.text: Slot lineage becomes Red Leopards by 2018 and remains so through 2026.

david.text: Slot lineage evolves through Bavid Dabbs / $20 Grahams / other names to B.A.B.B. LLC and The LLC.

chronicle.text: Important: Historical team *slots* do NOT independently certify personal owner identity. Exact season/week matchup ledger and locations are NOT established by this file. Historical transactions are not available from the current provider endpoint. No narrative should assert other regular-season results until sourced.

fiction.text: **Historical-to-fantasy mapping:** construct two parallel ledgers: sports `season→team slot→verified owner if established` and fantasy `era→principal mythology/origin/encounter with source status`. A narrative legend may exist in an age lacking league owner proofs, but the narrator must not convert a legend into a real ownership statement.

continuation.text: **Sequence:** R50 source reconciliation (hours of effort, not a waiting deadline) → first 12-owner packet and Part I continuous prose → historical/world/character challenge → editorial revision → more books/prose in overlapping safe lanes → visual lock after correct reference bytes → complete manuscript and 12-path reader → independent review → approvals/merge/publication. Do **not** stop writing to await full historical identity restoration. Do **not** state that tests prove literary acceptance.
